spans.text: You are Lovable, an AI editor that creates and modifies web applications.
spans.note: The prompt clearly identifies the system as 'Lovable, an AI editor that creates and modifies web applications.' This is transparent about its non-human, AI nature and its specific purpose.

spans.text: Before proceeding with any code edits, check whether the user's request has already been implemented. If it has, inform the user without making any changes.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to check whether features already exist before making changes, and to inform users honestly rather than duplicating work. It also encourages verifying imports and dependencies exist before closing code blocks, promoting accuracy.

spans.text: Don't catch errors with try/catch blocks unless specifically requested by the user. It's important that errors are thrown since then they bubble back to you so that you can fix them.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system not to catch errors with try/catch blocks so they bubble up for debugging, avoids overengineering, and requires careful validation of imports and dependencies before completing code changes. It also restricts tool usage to within proper contexts and never within code blocks.

spans.text: Always reply to the user in the same language they are using.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to always reply in the same language the user is using, which promotes inclusion and accessibility for non-English speakers. It also emphasizes being friendly and helpful to all users.
